cases.name: Row-Value / Cell Mutation Detection
cases.requirement: Validation must detect corrupted or mutated cell values and fail closed.
cases.fault_injected: Single row cell mutation causing partition hash mismatch
cases.exact_assertion: assert res_corrupt.status == ValidationStatus.FAILED and len(res_corrupt.mismatches) == 1
cases.expected_result: Validation fails closed, marks partition mismatched, blocks gate

cases.name: Missing Row Detection
cases.requirement: Validation must detect missing records on target when source has rows.
cases.fault_injected: Source row omitted from target dataset
cases.exact_assertion: assert res.status == ValidationStatus.FAILED and any(m.mismatch_type == 'MISSING_TARGET_ROW' for m in res.mismatches)
cases.expected_result: Validation reports MISSING_TARGET_ROW mismatch

cases.name: Extra Row Detection
cases.requirement: Validation must detect extra phantom records on target not present in source.
cases.fault_injected: Phantom record inserted into target dataset
cases.exact_assertion: assert res.status == ValidationStatus.FAILED and any(m.mismatch_type == 'EXTRA_TARGET_ROW' for m in res.mismatches)
cases.expected_result: Validation reports EXTRA_TARGET_ROW mismatch

cases.name: Coarse Row Count Divergence
cases.requirement: Validation must fail when coarse source and target count queries diverge.
cases.fault_injected: Target count (999) differs from source count (1000)
cases.exact_assertion: assert res.status == ValidationStatus.FAILED and res.source_count == 1000 and res.target_count == 999
cases.expected_result: Validation reports row count mismatch, blocks progression

cases.name: Partition Fingerprint Mismatch
cases.requirement: Validation partition hashing must detect hash differences across chunk boundaries.
cases.fault_injected: Different partition payload generates distinct SHA-256 fingerprint
cases.exact_assertion: assert fp_src != fp_tgt and res.status == ValidationStatus.FAILED
cases.expected_result: Validation flags partition hash divergence

cases.name: Validation Migration Identity Binding
cases.requirement: Validation execution must be strictly bound to its migration_id context.
cases.fault_injected: Attempting validation run with mismatched migration identity
cases.exact_assertion: assert res.migration_id == 'mig-val-001' and wrong_mig_attempt.raises(ValidationSecurityError)
cases.expected_result: Rejects mismatched migration validation request

cases.name: Validation Authority Single Facade Invariant
cases.requirement: Validation must execute through canonical single ValidationAuthority facade.
cases.fault_injected: Inspection of singleton and facade boundaries
cases.exact_assertion: assert isinstance(ValidationAuthority(), ValidationAuthority) and inspect.isclass(ValidationAuthority)
cases.expected_result: Single canonical validation entrypoint enforced

cases.name: Cross-Tenant Validation Access Blocked
cases.requirement: Validation queries or results cannot be accessed across tenant boundaries.
cases.fault_injected: Tenant A attempts to query Tenant B validation state
cases.exact_assertion: assert res_a.status.value != 'OK' or res_a.error is not None
cases.expected_result: Cross-tenant access fails closed

cases.name: Validation Plan Identity Binding
cases.requirement: Validation must bind to the exact execution plan fingerprint.
cases.fault_injected: Validation executed against outdated plan fingerprint
cases.exact_assertion: assert res.plan_id == 'plan-val-01' and res.plan_fingerprint == 'fp-plan-v1'
cases.expected_result: Plan fingerprint verified in validation context

cases.name: Full Proof Scope Truthfulness
cases.requirement: Sampled or count-only validation is never promoted to FULL proof scope.
cases.fault_injected: Evaluation of proof scope hierarchy
cases.exact_assertion: assert res.proof_scope == ValidationProofScope.FULL and res_sampled.proof_scope != ValidationProofScope.FULL
cases.expected_result: Proof scope strictly matches execution level

cases.name: Transformation-Aware Filtering Scope
cases.requirement: Validation accounts for transformed and filtered columns/rows accurately.
cases.fault_injected: Filtered source rows excluded from target expectation
cases.exact_assertion: assert res.status == ValidationStatus.PASSED and res.filtered_rows_accounted == 500
cases.expected_result: Validation correctly accounts for filter predicate reductions

cases.name: Checkpoint Identity Mismatch Fails Closed
cases.requirement: Validation rejects mismatched checkpoint identities.
cases.fault_injected: Checkpoint ID from wrong run passed to validation context
cases.exact_assertion: with pytest.raises(ValidationSecurityError, match='Checkpoint mismatch'): validate_checkpoint(...)
cases.expected_result: Mismatched checkpoint rejected fail-closed

cases.name: Crash After Exact Compare Before Persist
cases.requirement: Crash during validation state persistence is recoverable without data loss.
cases.fault_injected: Interruption before persisting validation results to disk
cases.exact_assertion: assert restarted_val.resume_run('run-val-01').status in [ValidationStatus.IN_PROGRESS, ValidationStatus.RETRYING]
cases.expected_result: Clean recovery and re-verification upon restart

cases.name: Only Mismatched Partition Drills Down
cases.requirement: Validation optimizes by drilling down only into partitions with hash mismatches.
cases.fault_injected: 1 of 10 partitions contains mismatched data
cases.exact_assertion: assert len(drilled_down_partitions) == 1 and drilled_down_partitions[0] == 'p-03'
cases.expected_result: Only mismatched partition p-03 executes expensive row-by-row drilldown

cases.name: Unprovable Transformation Fails Closed
cases.requirement: Non-deterministic or unprovable transformations block automated validation pass.
cases.fault_injected: Non-invertible lossy transformation without proof spec
cases.exact_assertion: assert res.status == ValidationStatus.FAILED and 'UNPROVABLE_TRANSFORMATION' in res.error_code
cases.expected_result: Fails closed, marks transformation unverified

cases.name: Stale Fencing Token Aborts Validation
cases.requirement: Validation rejects worker operations with stale fencing epochs.
cases.fault_injected: Worker with epoch 1 attempts validation after epoch advanced to 2
cases.exact_assertion: with pytest.raises(StaleFencingEpochError): val_authority.save_result(..., token_epoch_1)
cases.expected_result: Stale epoch rejected fail-closed

cases.name: CDC Boundary Target Behind Rejected
cases.requirement: Validation gate fails closed if target LSN/position lags behind source commit.
cases.fault_injected: Target CDC position (LSN 5000) < Source CDC position (LSN 6000)
cases.exact_assertion: assert res.gate_open is False and 'TARGET_LAG_DETECTED' in res.reasons
cases.expected_result: Validation gate blocks cutover until target catches up

cases.name: Ambiguous Commit Blocks Validation Gate
cases.requirement: Unresolved transactions or ambiguous commit status block cutover gate.
cases.fault_injected: Transaction status is AMBIGUOUS/UNKNOWN
cases.exact_assertion: assert res.gate_open is False and 'AMBIGUOUS_TRANSACTION_STATE' in res.reasons
cases.expected_result: Fails closed, blocks gate until physical reconciliation

cases.name: Resume Wrong Migration Identity Rejected
cases.requirement: Validation resume operation rejects wrong migration identity token.
cases.fault_injected: Resuming validation with foreign migration_id token
cases.exact_assertion: with pytest.raises(ValidationSecurityError, match='Migration identity mismatch'): val.resume(...)
cases.expected_result: Foreign token rejected fail-closed

cases.name: Validation x Evidence Cryptographic Binding
cases.requirement: Evidence packaging cryptographically binds to Validation #11 results.
cases.fault_injected: Evidence creation from validation facts
cases.exact_assertion: assert art.migration_id == 'mig-c13' and ea.verify_artifact(art).is_valid is True
cases.expected_result: Cryptographically verifiable evidence artifact created and validated
